name: Portuguese decimals use a comma separator
description: Portuguese, like Spanish, uses a comma as the decimal separator. A decimal value on a /pt page must show a comma where the English page shows a dot. This catches a number-formatting layer that only handled English.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the first match id
Navigate to /pt/match/<captured-id>, open a tab showing a decimal value (odds or prediction percentage), and read the formatted number
Verify the decimal value on the Portuguese page uses a comma decimal separator (e.g. 2,45) rather than a dot. If the /pt decimal is rendered with a dot separator, the test fails.
